items.docs:
Minimal, monochromatic atomic design system with warm stone grays and terracotta orange accent. Requires Tailwind CSS v4.

## Three themes
- **Warm** (default, applied via `:root`) — Sanzo Wada earth-tones, terracotta accent
- **Dark** (`.dark` class) — deep cold stone grays
- **Light** (`.light` class) — warm off-whites

## Three fonts
- `font-display` — Plus Jakarta Sans (headings)
- `font-body` — Satoshi (body text)
- `font-mono` — JetBrains Mono (code/data)

## Three surfaces
`background` → `surface` → `card` creates depth without complexity.

## Setup
1. Install Tailwind v4: `npm i -D tailwindcss@^4 @tailwindcss/vite@^4`
2. Add `@tailwindcss/vite` to `vite.config.ts` plugins
3. In your `src/index.css`: `@import "tailwindcss"; @import "tw-animate-css";`
4. Run `npx shadcn@latest add https://democrito.design/r/democrito.json`

See https://democrito.design for the full showcase.
